items.program_name: 雇用創出税額控除(OH JCTC)
items.category: 訓練・インフラ・その他
items.summary: Synchrony BankがOH州West Chester Townshipで300人の新規雇用と年間$16.5Mの新規給与を計画し、Ohio Tax Credit Authorityから9年間1.464%の雇用創出税額控除(JCTC)を承認された。
items.verbatim: Ohio Tax Credit Authority approved a Job Creation Tax Credit of 1.464% for 9 years on 2022-07-25 for a project in West Chester Township, Butler County. Commitment: create 300 full-time equivalent employees generating $16,500,000 in new annual payroll at the project location.
